title: Novoshakhtinsk oil refinery, oil pumping station in Samara region targeted for second time this week
summary: Drones attacked several oil facilities in Russia overnight into Saturday, November 28, including the Novoshakhtinsk oil refinery for the second time in a week.

title: War update: 146 clashes over past day, heaviest fighting on Kostiantynivka, Huliaipole axes
summary: A total of 146 combat engagements between Ukraine's Defense Forces and Russian invaders were recorded along the front line on November 27, with the heaviest fighting taking place in the Kostiantynivka and Huliaipole sectors.

title: Air defenses down 141 of 162 Russian drones launched against Ukraine overnight
summary: Ukraine's air defense forces neutralized 141 of the 162 drones used by Russian invaders to attack Ukraine since the evening of November 27.

title: Ukraine commemorates victims of Holodomor famines
summary: On Saturday, November 28, Ukraine commemorates the victims of the Holodomor famines.

title: Russians launch 701 attacks on Zaporizhzhia region in past day, one killed, five injured
summary: Russian occupation forces launched 701 attacks on 49 settlements in the Zaporizhzhia region over the past day, killing one person and injuring five others.

title: Russian army loses 2,825 troops, 10 air defense systems in war against Ukraine in past day
summary: Russia's total combat losses since the start of its full-scale invasion of Ukraine, from February 24, 2022, to November 28, 2026, have reached approximately 1,650,986 personnel, including 2,825 troops killed or wounded over the past day.

title: Two people injured in Russian strike on transport infrastructure in Dnipro
summary: Two people were injured when Russian forces struck transport infrastructure in Dnipro on Friday.

title: Ukrainian forces strike 15 Russian military depots in one week
summary: Ukraine’s Defense Forces struck 15 Russian military depots between November 19 and 26.

title: Memorial unveiled in Kyiv to British journalist Gareth Jones, who exposed Holodomor
summary: A memorial has been unveiled in Kyiv to British journalist Gareth Jones, one of the first Western journalists to report on the Holodomor in the 1930s.

title: Nine more children return to Ukraine through Melania Trump’s efforts
summary: Nine more children have been returned to Ukraine from the temporarily occupied territories of Ukraine and from Russia, thanks to the efforts of Melania Trump.

title: Polish prosecutors reveal expert findings on causes of Smolensk air disaster
summary: The Smolensk air disaster on 10 April 2010 was caused by a series of events during the final stage of the landing manoeuvre, including the aircraft’s unstable descent, an incorrect assessment of its actual altitude and a belated decision to abort the landing.

title: Ukraine's tattoo identification database for unidentified bodies now contains nearly 1,000 images
summary: The database of tattoo images found on unidentified bodies in Ukraine now contains nearly 1,000 entries.

title: EUROCONTROL extends support for Ukraine's air navigation system through 2028
summary: EUROCONTROL member states have agreed to extend the European ATM Voluntary Solidarity Fund for another two years, covering 2027 and 2028.

title: Ukraine's Missing Persons Register now holds data on over 117,000 people
summary: The Unified Register of Persons Missing Under Special Circumstances currently contains information on more than 117,000 people.

title: Russian commanders threatened with being sent on assault missions over lack of progress in Zaporizhzhia sector – ATESH
summary: The Russian military command is threatening to send commanders on assault missions over the lack of progress in the Zaporizhzhia sector.
